newsitem.title: SPAIN: Michelin says no plan for capital increase.
newsitem.headline: Michelin says no plan for capital increase.

text.p: Michelin finance director Eric Bourdais de Charbonniere said the French tyre company had no plans to propose a capital increase.

He told reporters on a tour of Michelin's tyre testing facility in the southern Spanish town of Almeria that there was "no basis" for the rumours of a capital increase that have recently circulated in the French stockmarket. "It's not on the agenda," he said.
If, in the months ahead, Michelin were to make a significant acquisition, it might have to raise capital, he said, but barring such an event, one is not being envisaged.
